meta.frame: All coordinates are planetocentric latitude and east longitude in the lunar mean Earth / polar axis (ME) frame, as published by the cited source. No PA-to-ME conversion was needed.
meta.rule: Every coordinate has a citation. Sites marked derive are computed by tools/terrain/make_terrain.py from the cited data product by the stated rule; nothing is typed from memory.

sites.name: Shackleton-de Gerlache connecting ridge
sites.source: Barker et al. 2021, Planet. Space Sci. 203, 105119, Table 2: Site 1, RoI 4 centroid, stereographic X = -11.2875 km, Y = -12.1675 km
sites.note: Lat/lon converted from the published polar-stereographic X/Y (R = 1737.4 km). One of the best-lit small areas known near the pole.

sites.note: Derived point, not a mission target.

sites.name: Chang'e-4, Von Karman (far side)
sites.source: Liu et al. 2019, Nature Communications 10, 4229: 177.5991 E, 45.4446 S, -5935 m
sites.note: CNSA. First far-side landing, 2019-01-03. Earth never rises here. The position was derived from Chang'E-2 imagery and terrain; its offset from the LRO-based ME frame used for the other sites was not assessed.
